_comment: Columns the server queries whose ONLY creator is a migration on no durable apply path — they exist on no real database, so the statements naming them raise 42703. Every entry needs a written reason; an empty one fails the guard. Resolve an entry (put its migration on an applier after the file that creates the table, or delete the dead reference), then remove it here. Goal: empty.

analytical_methods.method_type.reason: Decided 2026-09-22, not pending. server/services/cmc/ich-compliance-checker.ts SELECTs method_name, method_type, purpose, validation_status and the *_data columns from public.analytical_methods, whose deployed shape (shared/schema.ts: an organization method library with no project key) has none of them; 42703 by PREPARE on the reference DB. It fails HONESTLY: safe() records unavailable.methods, checkQ2 returns Q2_NOT_EVALUATED and the overall status is 'incomplete', which CmcQuality.tsx shows as 'some checks could not run' — nothing is fabricated. The fix is a new project-scoped reader over cmc_source_objects (source_type='method'), the store the Module 3 composer already compiles 3.2.S.4/3.2.P.5 from, replacing three inline SELECTs. CMC is outside the launch catalog, so under CLAUDE.md RULE 2 that work belongs to the CMC workstream, not this one.
